title: Choose the visual world for Brett Sabol Plumbing
question: Safer hand, as asked: three familiar directions built on the real logo and the blue and red, plus the category standard. Pick one.

options.label: Work Order
options.lineage: The carbonless job ticket a plumber leaves on your counter
options.thesis: Clear, written-down service: the site reads like an honest work order, itemized and signed.
options.viewport: White page with the real logo up top, a plain-spoken headline and call button at left, and a service-request ticket at right where the visitor ticks the problem and sends it. Real job photos start at the fold.
options.risk: Calm and trustworthy but quiet. The form styling has to stay light or it starts to feel like paperwork.

options.label: Pipe Markers
options.lineage: Color-banded pipe labels and flow arrows in a well-kept mechanical room
options.thesis: The site is labeled like a tidy boiler room: each service is a color band with a flow arrow pointing you to it.
options.viewport: Headline and call button on white, then full-width color bands with arrows naming Plumbing, Heating and Jet Drain Cleaning, each one a link to its page.
options.risk: Tidy and industrial, closest to a commercial contractor. Homeowners may find it a touch technical.

options.label: Shop Drawing
options.lineage: Plumbing riser diagrams and isometric shop drawings
options.thesis: Master-level planning shown as the drawing behind the job: fine isometric pipe lines and a title block frame the real photos.
options.viewport: White page, a thin isometric riser drawing behind the headline, the license number in a drawing title block, and the van photo framed as Detail A with a callout.
options.risk: Blueprint linework is a familiar trades-site move and can fade into wallpaper.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The premium plumber site played straight, at the craft level of Roto-Rooter, Benjamin Franklin Plumbing and Mr. Rooter.
canonCard.viewport: The van photo with headline and two buttons at left, a trust row of verified credentials, and service cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
